knowledge-base.overview: UIKit guardrails, patterns, and best practices for iOS 12+, Swift 5.0+. Covers MVVM + Coordinator architecture, programmatic Auto Layout, thin view controllers, Combine bindings, UITableView / UICollectionView with Diffable Data Sources, Compositional Layout, delegation pattern, memory management, and XCTest view controller testing. Applies to .swift files using UIKit.

core-principles.principle: Separate view logic (ViewController), presentation logic (ViewModel), and navigation (Coordinator). View controllers are configured by view models and do not contain business logic.
Build views in code with Auto Layout constraints. Avoid storyboards in team projects — they create merge conflicts and hide layout logic.
View controllers call setupUI(), setupConstraints(), and setupBindings() in viewDidLoad. All other logic lives in view models, services, or coordinators.
Use delegate protocols for callbacks between components. Always declare delegate properties as weak to prevent retain cycles.
Use [weak self] in all escaping closures and Combine sinks. Cancel subscriptions in deinit. Call prepareForReuse() to reset cell state.

guardrail.rule: Always set translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false before activating Auto Layout constraints on a programmatic view.
guardrail.bad: view.addSubview(label) label.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.topAnchor).isActive = true // crashes if not set

guardrail.rule: Declare all delegate properties as weak var to prevent retain cycles.
Use [weak self] in all escaping closures and all Combine .sink calls.
Use required init?(coder:) with fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") in all programmatic-only view controllers.
guardrail.good: required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

guardrail.rule: Keep view controllers under 200 lines. Extract views, cells, helpers, and extensions into separate files.
Never put networking or business logic in view controllers. Call view model methods; observe published state.
Pin to safeAreaLayoutGuide for top and bottom content edges — never to the plain view edges.
Always override prepareForReuse() in table and collection view cells. Reset all dynamic content and cancel image loads.
Use NSLayoutConstraint.activate([]) to batch-activate constraints. Never activate constraints one by one with isActive = true.
Use final class for all view controllers and cells unless explicitly designed for subclassing.

notes.note: Group by feature, not by type — Controllers/ and ViewModels/ live inside each feature folder
Core/ for infrastructure: networking, storage, utilities
Shared/ for reusable UI components used across features
One primary type per file; file named after the type
